text:
Rina Gomez: Idea — small OSS launch post for a community-focused refapp: 'Routing inference for multi-tenant demos' with a step-by-step tutorial + bench. Objective: drive PRs and community forks.

Ethan K: Nice. What distribution? blog + repo + short demo video?

Rina Gomez: blog + repo + 20s demo gif. Also a short checklist for community maintainers to add plugins. Keep tutorial runnable in <10 minutes.

Maya Patel: double down on "how to contribute" in the README and include a CONTRIBUTING.md with simple first-issue tags. KPIs: forks, PRs, stars, and demo requests.

Samir Rao: for benchmarks, I'll produce a tiny comparative table: hosted small, dedicated emulation, and quantized CPU. One chart PNG + raw CSV. ETA Mon.

Leo (Design): I can create a hero screenshot and a small badge for "starter-friendly". Prefer to get the demo running first so I can capture.

Rina Gomez: owners: Rina (launch copy + repo readme), Ethan (demo code + video gif), Samir (bench), Leo (assets). Launch window next Thursday.

Ethan K: technical constraints: demo must be 3 files max, include a run.sh that wraps setup. Use a tiny model that fits on CPU for reproducibility. I'll add model pins and recommended quant flags.

Maya Patel: messaging: lead with a short user story — "Ship a multi-tenant chat demo in 10 minutes." Then a bench callout: "real numbers, not lab claims". CTA: "Fork the repo and open a 'starter' PR".

Samir Rao: quick note: need a small hosted credit for the hosted run screenshot. Can marketing allocate $40?

Rina Gomez: I'll request credits.

launch-bot: Reminder set: draft-review at 1974501300 by Rina Gomez.

Ethan K: I'll aim to push a draft demo branch by Fri EOD. Will include a minimal Dockerfile option.

Leo (Design): once demo branch exists I'll grab screenshots and prepare hero image variants for social.

Maya Patel: inbound routing: GH issue template -> label "starter-demo" -> auto-post to #community-demos -> marketing collects leads via simple form (name, org, use-case). If domain looks enterprise, ping sales.

Rina Gomez: good. Jamie (DevRel) - can you bake a quick 'how to route leads' snippet we can copy into the post?

Samir Rao: small reproducibility request: publish the raw CSV + the script used to produce it in /assets/bench/ so users can rerun easily.

Maya Patel: agreed. Also add a short 'expected results' section in the README so people know if their run matches ours.

Rina Gomez: blockers?

Ethan K: permissions to publish branch. @repo-bot can you create the branch refs/oss-routing-starter and add me?

launch-bot: Branch request queued for refs/oss-routing-starter.

Rina Gomez: thanks. I'll draft the post and share for review at 1974501300. Let's keep the launch lean and community-first. :rocket:

Maya Patel: sounds great. Schedule social for Thurs 10am PT.

Leo (Design): :thumbsup: 

Ethan K: starting demo now.

launch-bot: Action required: review by Rina Gomez at 1974501300
